retryTiming.implementation: Pending valid retry suppresses pre-retry stall classification. An admitted retry retains its actual issue time and receives the existing8-second stall observation interval. No physical-progress timestamp or fixed deadline is renewed. Planning and command admission both refuse after the original bound deadline; hard expiry takes TIME_LIMIT precedence.
retryTiming.limits: Quorum/majority handoff, ownership changes and hard expiry remain independent endings. No guarantee of8seconds uninterrupted actor movement or actual native acknowledgement.
